title: Italian MEP on hunger strike over humanitarian crisis in Russian-occupied Oleshky
lede: An Italian MEP has gone on hunger strike over the besieged Ukrainian town's lack of access to food, medicine, clean water and basic care. The only route to escape is tapped with mines and rife with attack drones.
